issue_title: [Bug] Race condition in TodoApp operations: load-modify-save pattern without locking

scorecard.root_cause_description: Race condition in load-modify-save pattern: multiple processes can read the same state, modify independently, and overwrite each other's changes
scorecard.fix_approach: File-based locking using filelock library to ensure atomicity of load-modify-save operations
scorecard.tests_description: Added comprehensive test suite with 5 tests covering concurrent add/remove/mark_done operations, lock timeout configuration, and lock release on exceptions

risks: Lock file (.json.lock) is created alongside the database file - cleanup may be needed if process crashes
limitations: Lock timeout is set to 30 seconds by default - very long operations may timeout
